title: Structural Crack Movement Trend
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=crackmeter:reading
| timechart span=1w avg(width_mm) as width by crack_id
| streamstats current=f last(width) as prev by crack_id
| eval widening=if(width-prev>0.2,1,0)
description: Trends the width of monitored cracks over time and flags any that are steadily widening.
value: Most cracks are cosmetic, but a steadily widening one can signal subsidence; trending catches real movement early.
implementation: Ingest crack-gauge readings into `index=personal`; alert on sustained widening.
visualization: Line chart of crack width over time with widening flags.
grandmaExplanation: It measures monitored cracks in the walls over time and warns if any is slowly getting wider.
